hypothesis: A LinUCB contextual bandit selects more beneficial question-person pairs than the rule selector with identical candidate pools and hard gates.

variants.description: non-contextual per-recipient running mean, epsilon 0.1 (simulator only)
LinUCB alpha 0.5; simulator learns online; family arm trained on train families per seed, frozen artifact scored on validation

familyArm.learning: LinUCB.update from harness-labelled EvaluationRecords; assessedBenefit = 1 if the answer moved the recommendation to the key expected class, 0 if answered without that change, null if unanswered
familyArm.seedsMean: LinUCB is deterministic given its data; the seed sets the ORDER of training families

config.benefitDefinition: mean over investigations of the labelled benefit of their questions (unanswered and no-question investigations contribute 0 to the numerator; the denominator is all investigations)

acceptanceCriteria: bandit ships behind the setting only if mean benefit on validation > rules by >= 0.05 with all 3 seeds above rules (each by >= 0.05) and 0 hard-rule violations; else rules stay (EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md E03)
simulator arm: 0 ineligible selections asserted for every selector and seed
stopRule: stop if simulator rewards leak hidden truth into features (selectors see only eligible pairs and visible features)
